description: This file defines the interface IStorageManager for managing storage operations within the WPEFramework's Exchange namespace. It contains method declarations for creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage related to applications, along with associated documentation and licensing information.

classes.name: IStorageManager
classes.description: An interface for managing storage for applications, allowing creation, retrieval, deletion, and clearing of storage based on app IDs.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specified application ID with a given size, returning the storage path or an error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage location, size, and used space for a given application ID, user ID, and group ID.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a specified application ID, providing an error reason if applicable.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specific application ID, including device storage.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all application storage data except for those specified to be exempted.
